package.name: catbot_bringup
package.description:
Top-level launch-only package that brings up the full on-robot Ankybot V3 locomotion + voice-command stack in one command: BNO085 IMU (ankybot_imu), PCA9685/Mega I2C actuation (ankybot_i2c_bridge, C++), the ONNX policy runner (ankybot_policy_runner), and speech-to-cmd_vel (speech_detection). Composes each package's own launch file rather than duplicating node definitions - update the owning package's launch file when a node's parameters change, not this one.
2026-07-20: gates the whole stack behind two sequential pre-flight checks, run before any node starts - scripts/check_i2c_devices.py (bundled with this package) confirms the PCA9685/Mega/BNO085 all ack their addresses, then ankybot_imu's imu_diag.py confirms the BNO085's accelerometer/gyroscope/rotation-vector actually produce readable samples. Either check failing aborts the launch with a clear report of which device/stage failed, instead of the three previously-inconsistent per-node failure behaviors (see CLAUDE.md's I2C node failure-behavior table).
